page: Amazon Web Services m9gd.12xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the AWS Graviton ARMv9 Neoverse-V3 processor. Operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz, this server provides 48 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core. The hardware configuration includes 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance features 2850 GB of NVMe SSD instance store capacity. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps, managed via the AWS Nitro hypervisor.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance in several areas. The instance achieves top 10% placement in single-core and multi-core Geekbench evaluations, software compilation, and text and image processing. Its memory subsystem demonstrates strong capabilities, with a top-tier PassMark memory score and high-speed small-block read-only memory bandwidth. Database operations are highly efficient, as evidenced by top-tier performance in Redis SET operations and PassMark database tests, alongside top-tier static web serving throughput. However, while prompt processing for small language models is highly efficient, text generation speeds for small models fall into the bottom 10%.

The m9gd.12xlarge offers a balanced resource profile, combining dedicated ARMv9 compute cores with high-capacity local NVMe storage. This architecture provides qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring high-speed local data access without the overhead of external network storage. The server is well-suited for database hosting, Redis caching layers, software compilation pipelines, static web serving, and general-purpose enterprise applications.
